newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 30-yr bond yield seen at 6.63 pct. [CORRECTED 18:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 30-yr bond yield seen at 6.63 pct. [CORRECTED 18:05 GMT]

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $10.0 billion in 30-year bonds (corrects from 10-year notes) on Thursday is expected to produce an average yield near 6.63 percent, dealers said.
At 1225 EST/1725 GMT, the 30-year bonds were quoted at 6.630 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
